name: Paradox
detailed_description:
You’re not just fighting for survival.
You’re fighting across time itself.

One moment you’re dodging a spectral trap in the shadow of a cursed pyramid. The next, you're sprinting through the gaslit alleys of Victorian London, heartbeat thundering in your ears as something ancient hunts you through the fog.

Welcome to Paradox — an intense, 1v4 online co-op experience where timelines collide, and every match drops you into a different era with new threats, new tactics… and no room for mistakes.

You and your team aren't just survivors. You're anomalies—each wielding supernatural powers torn from the fabric of time. Blink across space. Control shadows. Burn the past into the present. Every character plays differently, and mastering your role can be the difference between victory and a brutal, timeless death.

But here’s the twist: one of you is the Hunter.

And the Hunter always knows where you’ve been.

What to Expect:

Timelines That Fight Back
Battle through immersive maps ripped straight from history—and warped by something dark. Ancient Egypt. Victorian London. A shattered future no one escaped from.

Asymmetrical Chaos
1 vs 4. One player becomes the Hunter, armed with powers meant to overwhelm. The others? They survive, complete objectives, and turn the tables—if they can.

Play Your Power
Five unique characters. Five playstyles. From stealthy escapes to raw supernatural force, every power has a counter. Every decision matters.

No Solo Heroes Here
Survival takes teamwork. Coordinate, distract, trap, or sacrifice—just don’t go alone.

A Story That Spans Centuries
The more you play, the more the truth unravels. What broke time? Why are you part of it? And what’s really hunting you?

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Time doesn’t care who you are.
But if you’re smart, fast, and just a little ruthless…
You might make it out alive.

Will you?
